description: Returns Vegagerðin status for Icelandic highland F-roads (F26, F35, F88, F208, F225, etc.), regional highland notifications, and explicit out-of-season notice when roads have no winter service (max 20).

open_only.description: Only return passable F-road segments (default false).

route.description: Optional F-road number or highland track (e.g. F26, F35, F208, Sprengisandur, Kjölur, Landmannalaugar).

name: get_highland_roads
title: Get Highland F-Road Opening Status (Vegagerðin)
